about: Audit verdicts that post-date or correct the 45-task pass (whose verdicts build_evidence.py reads from research/INTERNAL-trap-evidence.csv). Later records override earlier ones; any record here overrides the CSV. 'source' is relative to the workspace root and 'quote' must occur in it verbatim (whitespace-normalised): build_evidence.py checks every one and reports a drifted citation. Verdict classes: GENUINE / GENUINE-soft (section-14 audit or re-audit), BLIND-1.0 (an Opus blind reader reached the reference; provisional, reachable is not unique), UNCONFIRMED (not counted either way: a reader missed it, or a re-audit was unclear), AMBIGUOUS / DEFECT (excluded from every pooled rate).
